svg.title: Low-input control: fresh parent loading followed by a guided workpiece probe
svg.desc: Control schematic only. No finite-element solution or actual deformation is depicted. Stage A fixes the workpiece at q zero and increases mean mechanism input to 0.50 millimetres. Only after successful completion does Stage B hold this mean and prescribe rigid workpiece translation from zero to 0.025 millimetres. Y translation and rotation remain guided.

g.text: Same q, lower held mechanism input
PREPARATION ONLY / control diagram / not a finite-element result / not to scale
Same reference masks, material, boundary and solver gates
uy = 0, rotation = 0; q-arrow and shift are illustrative
A must finish successfully → admit its real terminal state → fresh q0 F/T with no repair
Compare with the existing d = 1.06 mm probe
Exact shared q: 0 and 0.025 mm. Keep all extra accepted states; no interpolation.
Q, material / Hu components, each q0 increment, input reaction, actual gaps, J / Hu, convergence.
Half-model force includes t = 20 mm: Q = −F_body,x. Full symmetric axial force = 2Q; q is unchanged.
Guided response / high-minus-low is not automatically contact-only force or bearing capacity.
Unchanged: alpha 2.5e−7, gamma 1e−6, r 9 mm, centre (80,40), right 92 mm, Lr 80 mm, original masks and gates.
